name: situational_awareness_brief
description: ONE grounded key-player briefing that fuses live tower health + top worker needs + trading-desk PnL/exposure + council board state into a single read. Use this at the start of any leadership turn ('what's the state of the tower', 'brief me', 'what should I do next') so Wren speaks and acts from the whole real picture at once. Composes the live_tower_status, worker_needs_digest, trading_desk_briefing and council_board_digest skills. All read-only, all R01-honest.
